newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Astra Intl may get new commissioners.
newsitem.headline: Astra Intl may get new commissioners.

text.p: Indonesia's largest car maker PT Astra International said on Tuesday the company might change its board of commissioners but declined comment on possible changes in the board of directors.
"There may be a change (on the board of commissioners). As you know Astra is going to have a shareholders' meeting on February 19," Astra's finance director Rini Suwandi told reporters.

On Tuesday, the company sent a letter to the Jakarta Stock Exchange saying it would hold an extraordinary general shareholders' meeting on February 19 to discuss the change in the board of commissioners.
Suwandi said Astra had earlier received a letter from shareholders who proposed a meeting to discuss a number of issues which included the board of commissioners.
Suwandi declined to comment on market talks that she was the strongest candidate to become the company's president director.
